units.source_text: 他觉得事后回思也深可感慨。

en.t: Even when he thought back on it afterward, he felt it was deeply moving.

units.source_text: 此时二条院中高僧齐集，七七中规定的念佛自不必说，

en.t: At this time, eminent monks gathered at the Nijo estate; needless to say, the prescribed nenbutsu rites for the forty-nine days were performed,

units.source_text: 此外又命虔诵《法华经》，哀悼之情无限。

en.t: and in addition he ordered the Lotus Sutra to be reverently recited, showing boundless grief and mourning.
